entities.summary: Jaime Andrés Bassa Mercado is a Chilean attorney and politician serving as deputy since 11 March 2026. Bassa has served as the Vice President of the Constitutional Convention of Chile from 2021 to 2022. He is a member of the left-wing political party Broad Front.
